label: frozen
purpose: the frozen business date of every fixture

label: sweep
purpose: the month-end revalidation sweep of journey J6: seeded due dates up to this date are due

label: leap-day
purpose: legacy PRVRSK01 copies month and day into the year 2033 and makes the impossible date 20330229 (R-PRVRSK01-ADD-02, Q-017)

label: century-pivot
purpose: legacy 2-digit due year 70 is read as 1970 by the pivot at 70 (R-PRVRSK01-cbl-00044, D-004)
